notes.title: WILD Tactics is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43549437/7ffb7d8c556c5435097a922a96d9e8202b253950.jpg[/img]

WILD Tactics is a brand new tactical strategy/squad management game set in the World of Wilderness, with a focus on unique characters, social mechanics, and a hellishly wild narrative.

It features the well-known XCOM-like combat system with unique takes on the beloved gameplay mechanics.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43549437/5fe892dce79e430f0178e18a08efb34182ebc6c0.jpg[/img]

The game emphasizes the narrative as much as the combat! Get to know the ragtag crew of misfits, assemble your favorite team, and witness as the story unfolds through cutscenes and dialogues in 15 action-packed story-oriented missions.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43549437/56a8b2e097e62157cb66f6f2d433bf580f29c7f7.jpg[/img]

- 12 hero characters with deep backstories and complex relationships
- 15 huge story-oriented missions
- Plenty of side-missions
- Squad and base management
- Weapon upgrading
- A unique and meaningful social system
- And an amazing original soundtrack

[b]Wishlist it now![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384640/WILD_Tactics/
